audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Storm theophany, waters, thunder, Lebanon, wilderness, temple, flood, strength, and peace.

verses.restored: Give unto YHWH, O ye mighty, give unto YHWH glory and strength.

familiar.text: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

modern.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

original.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז

verses.restored: Give unto YHWH the glory due unto his name; worship YHWH in the beauty of holiness.

familiar.text: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

modern.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.

original.text: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: The voice of YHWH is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: YHWH is upon many waters.

familiar.text: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

modern.text: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.

original.text: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים

verses.restored: The voice of YHWH is powerful; the voice of YHWH is full of majesty.

familiar.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

modern.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

original.text: קוֹל יְהוָ֥ה בַּכֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הוָ֗ה בֶּהָדָֽר

verses.restored: The voice of YHWH breaketh the cedars; yea, YHWH breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

familiar.text: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

modern.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

original.text: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן

verses.restored: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

familiar.text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

notes.title: Re’em and Sirion
notes.body: Re’em is a wild ox, not the mythical unicorn of later English tradition. Sirion is an ancient name for Mount Hermon.

modern.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

original.text: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן רְאֵמִֽים

verses.restored: The voice of YHWH divideth the flames of fire.

familiar.text: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

modern.text: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.

verses.restored: The voice of YHWH shaketh the wilderness; YHWH shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

familiar.text: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

modern.text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

original.text: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: The voice of YHWH maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

familiar.text: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

modern.text: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

original.text: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד

verses.restored: YHWH sitteth upon the flood; yea, YHWH sitteth King for ever.

familiar.text: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

modern.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

original.text: יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH will give strength unto his people; YHWH will bless his people with peace.

familiar.text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

modern.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Storm imagery must not be used to claim natural disasters are punishments for particular people or communities.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
